terms.whoBody: AYWO ("Across Years, We're One") is published by {{company}}, CIN {{cin}}, registered office {{address}}. Contact: {{email}}, {{website}}.
terms.accountBody: You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time code. Keep your phone safe, because whoever holds it can sign in as you. One person, one account. You must give true details and be old enough to agree to these terms where you live. Anyone under 18 needs a parent or guardian's consent.
terms.familyBody: What you add stays yours. You give AYWO permission to store it and show it to the people you share it with, only to run the service. The tree itself is free. You can download a copy of it at any time.
terms.othersBody: A family tree holds details of other people, some of them living. Add only what is true and what you believe they would be comfortable with. Do not add anyone's contact details without their agreement. Do not use AYWO to harass, mislead or harm anyone, to send advertising, or to collect details about people.
terms.plusBody: AYWO Plus is a paid subscription for a family of up to six. Inside the apps it is sold through Apple or Google, and on the web through Razorpay or Stripe. It renews on its own until you cancel. Cancel in the store or on the web where you bought it: deleting your account does not cancel it. A free trial, where offered, turns into a paid plan unless cancelled before it ends. Our Return and refund policy explains when you get money back.
terms.removalTitle: Asking for something to be removed
terms.removalBody: Anyone added to a tree without agreeing can ask for removal through the takedown form, with or without an account. AYWO Admins review these requests and may remove a person from a tree.
terms.endingBody: You can delete your account in the app at any time. It is deleted 30 days later, unless you sign in and keep it. A tree you created passes to its successor or a Co-creator, and with neither it is closed. We may block an account that breaks these terms.
terms.liabilityBody: AYWO is offered as it is. Family details come from families, and relationship words may be wrong, so please don't rely on them for legal, medical or inheritance matters. The SOS and alert features depend on your phone and network: they do not replace emergency services. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect loss.
terms.changesBody: We may change these terms. When a change matters, we will tell you in the app and ask you to agree again before it applies to you.
terms.lawBody: These terms follow the laws of India, and the courts in {{courtCity}} hear any dispute. Nothing here removes rights you have under consumer law. Questions and complaints: {{email}}. Grievance Officer: {{grievanceOfficer}}, {{grievanceEmail}}.
terms.ordersBody: Some things can be bought once: a printed family tree poster, a printed family book and premium invite designs. The price, including any tax and delivery charge, is shown before you pay. You are responsible for the details printed, so please check them first. Delivery, returns and refunds follow our Return and refund policy.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.whoBody: {{company}}, CIN {{cin}}, registered office {{address}}, runs AYWO and decides how your data is used. Privacy contact: {{email}}. Grievance Officer: {{grievanceOfficer}}, {{grievanceEmail}}.
privacy.collectBody: Your mobile number, name, photo, language and settings. What you and your relatives add to a family tree: names, dates, places, photos, notes and relationships. Your messages, memories, invitations and comments in the app. Whether you pay for AYWO Plus, though never your card or bank details. A delivery address, if you order something printed. A device token, so we can send notifications. Basic technical records, such as IP address, to keep the service safe. A random number made on your device, with its type (Android, iPhone or web) and language, to count how many people reach each step of getting started, such as signing in or starting a tree. It is not linked to your name, number or account. If you fill in the emergency card: the health details you type (blood group, allergies, health conditions, medicines), kept only with your separate agreement, shown only to the people an SOS you send reaches, and deleted when you withdraw.
privacy.contactsBody: Your login number is used for signing in and for finding you in a tree someone has already saved you in. We never show it to anyone. Phone numbers and emails on a person's card are shown only to those the tree's rules allow, and they never appear in history, logs, notifications or lists.
privacy.shareBody: Only the people a tree is shared with, at the level its Creator or Co-creator chose. Someone with a shared link sees names and photos only. We don't sell your data, we don't show advertising, and AYWO's staff see tree contents only when needed to handle a request, with a written reason on record.
privacy.providersBody: DigitalOcean stores our data and files. MSG91 and Twilio send sign-in codes and urgent text messages. SendGrid sends email, and Expo sends notifications. Apple, Google, RevenueCat, Razorpay and Stripe handle payments. Each gets only what it needs for that job, and data may be handled outside your country.
privacy.locationTitle: Location, photos and your phone's contacts
privacy.locationBody: AYWO reads your location only while you run an SOS, and shares it only with the people that SOS goes to, until it ends. It reads your photos and contacts only when you choose one to add.
privacy.keepBody: For as long as your account or the family tree exists. When you delete your account, we wait 30 days in case you change your mind. Then your name, number, photo and your own contact details go. Entries you added to a tree stay with that tree, because they belong to the family's history. Payment records are kept as long as the law requires.
privacy.rightsBody: You can see and correct your details, download a copy of your data, delete your account, withdraw consent and name someone to act for you. See each consent you gave, and withdraw it, on Me, Privacy and account, My consents. Complain to our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, at {{grievanceEmail}}. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can also go to the Data Protection Board of India. Someone who is not on AYWO can use the takedown form.
privacy.childrenBody: AYWO isn't meant for anyone under 18 to use without a parent or guardian's consent. Families may record children in a tree. A parent or guardian can ask us to change or remove a child's details.
privacy.changesBody: When this policy changes in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app. The version above shows which one you are reading.
privacy.cookiesBody: The website keeps your sign-in and settings in your browser, and a copy of your family tree without anyone's phone numbers, so it opens offline. Signing out removes the copy. We use no advertising cookies and nothing that follows you to other websites. When you pay on the website, Razorpay or Stripe may set their own cookies on their payment pages.
privacy.securityBody: Data travels encrypted, and access inside the app follows each tree's rules. Staff access is limited by role and recorded. No system is perfect: if a breach could affect you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.

refunds.title: Return and refund policy
refunds.summaryBody: You can cancel AYWO Plus at any time. Your family tree stays free, whatever happens to a paid plan. Printed items are made just for you, so they are replaced or refunded if something is wrong with them. Payments made through Apple or Google are refunded by Apple or Google.
refunds.cancelBody: On the website, open Family plan and choose Cancel subscription. In the apps, use Manage subscription, which opens the App Store or Google Play. After a paid period has started, Plus stays until that period ends and then stops for the whole family, with no further charge. If you cancel during the free months, Plus stops straight away and you pay nothing. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription, so cancel first.
refunds.webBody: Yearly plan: ask within {{refundDays}} days of a charge, including the first charge after the free months, for a full refund. After that, unused time is not refunded unless the law requires it. Monthly plan: a month that has started is not refunded. Whichever plan you use, we always refund a duplicate charge, or a charge taken after your cancellation was confirmed.
refunds.storesBody: Apple or Google took the payment, so only they can refund it, under their own rules. For Apple, go to reportaproblem.apple.com. For Google, go to your order history in Google Play. We cannot refund these ourselves, but we will help if you get stuck.
refunds.invitesBody: These are digital and ready to use straight away, so they are not refunded once used, unless the design did not work and we cannot fix it.
refunds.physicalBody: Each one is printed to order with your family's details, so it cannot be returned because you changed your mind. You can cancel for a full refund until printing starts.
refunds.damagedTitle: If something is wrong with your order
refunds.damagedBody: Tell us within {{damageDays}} days of delivery, with your order details and a photo. If the item is damaged, misprinted or not what you ordered, we will reprint it or refund you, at no cost, and you choose which. Keep the item until we reply; send it back only if we ask. A mistake in the details saved in your tree when you ordered is not a printing fault.
refunds.deliveryBody: Orders usually arrive within {{deliveryDays}} days of payment. Any delivery charge is shown before you pay. If an order is lost, or does not arrive well after that time, tell us and we will replace or refund it.
refunds.moneyBody: An approved refund goes back to the way you paid. We start it within {{refundWorkingDays}} working days. Your bank or card company may take a few more days to show it.
refunds.helpBody: Write to {{email}} or call {{phone}}. Please give the phone number on your AYWO account and your payment or order details. We reply to complaints within 48 hours and settle them within one month. If you are not happy with the answer, write to our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, at {{grievanceEmail}}.

trees.askText: You will see names only, never contact details. Your name and reason go in the audit log.
trees.lookRecorded: Recorded in the audit log. Reason: {{reason}}

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: New relationship words and reports of wrong words.
dictionary.approveText: It joins the dictionary for everyone.
dictionary.rejectText: It stays out of the dictionary.
dictionary.acceptText: With a corrected word below, the word is replaced and marked verified. With the box empty, the word is withdrawn.
dictionary.correctedNative: Corrected word, in its own script
dictionary.dismissText: The word stays as it is.
dictionary.takeBackTitle: Take "{{word}}" back out of the dictionary?
dictionary.takeBackText: It was approved, and people see it now. Taking it back removes it from the dictionary for everyone. You can approve it again from the Rejected list.
dictionary.searchingFor: Showing words that match "{{q}}". Search with an empty box to see all.
dictionary.correctText: The word stays approved. Everyone sees the new spelling at once.
dictionary.approveFixText: It joins the dictionary for everyone. If the spelling has a small mistake, put it right here before you approve.
dictionary.wordNativeHelp: Leave empty if there is none.
dictionary.willSaveCorrected: The word will be saved with your spelling.
dictionary.decidedHelp: Reports already decided, the newest first. The word is shown as it reads now.
dictionary.noDecided: No reports have been decided yet.

takedowns.title: Takedown requests
takedowns.subtitle: People asking to be removed from a tree someone else made.
takedowns.noPersonLinked: Not linked to a tree yet
takedowns.askedBy: How to reach the person asking
takedowns.note: Your note (recorded in the audit log)
takedowns.removeText: This person disappears from the tree, their contact details are deleted, and the tree's Creator is told. It can't be brought back from history.
takedowns.dismissText: Nothing changes in the tree. Reply to the person asking yourself.
takedowns.searchHelp: Type at least 2 letters of the name, then press Search.
takedowns.noMatch: Nobody with that name is in any tree. Try a shorter or different spelling.
takedowns.tooMany: Only the first 20 are shown. Type more of the name to narrow it down.
takedowns.needPerson: Still needed: pick which person to remove.
takedowns.reopenText: For a request dismissed by mistake. It goes back to Open and into the work queue, due in 72 hours. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
takedowns.reopened: The request is open again. You will find it under Open and in the work queue.
takedowns.finalRemoved: Final: the person was removed from the tree and can't be brought back.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Plans and payments. Order refunds are on the Orders page; plan refunds happen at the store or gateway.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: AYWO's own team. This has nothing to do with a tree's Creator.
staff.name: Name
staff.addText: Type the person's mobile number. If they already use AYWO they become staff now. If the number has never signed in, an invite waits for its first sign-in, for 14 days. To add back someone you removed, use "Removed from staff" below: no number needed.
staff.removeText: The account stays. Its staff access ends at once.
staff.adminHelp: An AYWO Admin can do everything, including managing staff and reading the audit log.
staff.teamRolesHelp: A team role is a named set of permissions. Changing a role changes everyone in it.
staff.resetText: They are signed out and must set up their authenticator app again at the next sign-in.
staff.invitedText: AYWO does not send this person any message. Please tell them yourself: sign in to AYWO with this number within 14 days, then open the admin page. They become staff at that first sign-in.
staff.roleChangesAll_one: {{count}} person has this role. Changes apply to them at once.
staff.roleChangesAll_other: {{count}} people have this role. Changes apply to them at once.
staff.cancelInviteText: This number will not become staff when it signs in. You can add it again later.
staff.needPhone: Type the full phone number with its country code.
staff.needPermission: Tick at least one permission, or choose a team role.
staff.promoteText: {{name}} will be able to do everything in this panel: add and remove staff and other AYWO Admins, change anyone's permissions, read the audit log, block accounts, refund orders, change app settings, and send notices to every member.
staff.promoteWarn: Give this only to someone who runs AYWO with you. Another AYWO Admin can take it away later.
staff.needRoleName: Type a role name of at least 2 letters.
staff.needRolePermission: Tick at least one permission for this role.
staff.deleteRoleText: Nobody has this role now. Once deleted it can't be brought back; you would have to make it again.
staff.deleteRoleBlocked: This role can be deleted only when nobody has it. Move its people to another role first.
staff.invitesHelp: AYWO sends no message for an invite. Tell the person to sign in with that number.
staff.changeInviteText: Saving also renews the invite for another 14 days.
staff.formerHelp: Add someone back with the role they had. No phone number to type. For safety they set up their second step again.
staff.addPersonText: This account already uses AYWO, so no phone number is needed. Choose what they can do.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every staff action. Nobody can change or delete this record.
audit.search: Search: an action (removed staff), a staff name, or a reason

actions.takedown_removed: Removed a person after a takedown
actions.ticket_answered_closed: Answered and closed a help ticket
actions.takedown_person_search: Searched for a person for a takedown
actions.ticket_closed: Closed a help ticket without an answer
actions.order_step_undone: Took an order one step back

broadcast.title: System notices
broadcast.subtitle: For things every member must know, such as planned downtime or a change in terms. Never for marketing.
broadcast.heading: Heading
broadcast.confirmText: It goes to every account by push and email, and it can't be taken back. The reason you write is kept in the audit log.
broadcast.limitNote: It goes to every member at once and cannot be taken back. At most 3 notices can be sent in a day.
broadcast.usedToday: {{used}} of the {{limit}} notices allowed in 24 hours have already been sent.
broadcast.usedUp: All {{limit}} notices allowed in 24 hours have been sent. Please wait before sending another.
broadcast.noHistory: No notice has been sent yet.

twoStep.codeText: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for AYWO staff. You'll be asked again in 12 hours.
twoStep.lost: Lost your phone? Ask an AYWO Admin to reset your second step.
twoStep.setupText: Staff accounts can see private data, so they need a second step: a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoStep.step1: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account with this setup key:
twoStep.step2: 2. Type the 6-digit code the app shows:
twoStep.againText: Your 12-hour staff sign-in has ended. Type a new 6-digit code from your authenticator app to carry on. The page underneath, and anything you typed on it, is still there.
twoStep.needsCode: Type all 6 digits of the code.
twoStep.qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
twoStep.orKey: Scan the square with your authenticator app. Or type this key into it:

work.title: Work queue
work.subtitle: Everything waiting for staff, in one place. Give each item an owner, keep it moving, and finish before the deadline.
work.goTo: Go to the page to decide
work.noteHelp: Staff only. The person never sees this.
work.noteFirst: Add your note, or clear it, before leaving this item.
work.needNote: Write a note to add it.
work.doneHelp: "Done" only ticks this off the work queue. The ticket, report or request itself is answered on its own page: use "Go to the page to decide". Deciding it there marks this done by itself.

reports.title: Abuse reports
reports.subtitle: What people reported about memories, comments, chat messages and accounts. Decide each within 24 hours.
reports.removeText: It disappears for everyone. Every open report about it closes, and the people who reported it are told action was taken.
reports.removeProfileText: The account is blocked: signed out everywhere and unable to sign in.
reports.dismissText: Nothing changes. The person who reported it is told it was looked at.
reports.reopenText: For a "Keep it" pressed by mistake. The report goes back to Open and into the work queue, due in 24 hours. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
reports.reopened: The report is open again. You will find it under Open and in the work queue.
reports.finalRemoved: Final: the content was removed and can't be put back from here.

tickets.title: Help tickets
tickets.subtitle: Questions from the app's help centre. Your answers show as "AYWO Support", never your own name.
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.replyHelp: The person gets a notification and reads it in the app.
tickets.isClosed: This ticket is closed. A reply from the person opens it again, or reopen it yourself to answer.
tickets.searching: Showing tickets that match "{{q}}". Search with the box empty to see every ticket again.
tickets.emptySearch: No tickets match your search here. Try "All", or fewer letters.
tickets.answerFirst: Send your answer, or clear it, before leaving this ticket.
tickets.closeOnlySure: Close this ticket without an answer? The person gets no message. If they write again, it opens again.
tickets.closeOnlyBlocked: You have written an answer: use "Send and close", or clear it first.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Posters and books from paid to delivered. The buyer is told at each step.
orders.search: Buyer's name or phone, city, order number, tracking number or payment reference
orders.cancelText: The buyer gets a notification that the order is cancelled.
orders.refundText: The money goes back through Razorpay or Stripe to the way the buyer paid. This can't be undone.
orders.addressText: Write why you need the address. It's recorded in the audit log.
orders.noAddress: This order has no shipping address.
orders.stepDone: Saved. The order is now: {{step}}. The buyer has been told.
orders.cancelNoRefund: Cancelling does not give the money back. The buyer paid {{amount}}, and it stays paid until someone refunds it.
orders.cancelThenRefund: After you cancel, you will be asked whether to refund it straight away.
orders.cancelRefundElsewhere: This payment can't be refunded from here. After you cancel, refund it at the payment provider.
orders.cancelNeedsPayments: You don't have the Payments permission, so you can't refund. After you cancel, ask someone who has it to refund this order. It stays in the Cancelled list marked "Paid, not refunded".
orders.cancelDoneNoRefund: The order is cancelled and the buyer has been told. It has not been refunded: find it under Cancelled, marked "Paid, not refunded".
orders.refundAfterCancelText: The order is cancelled, but the buyer has not got the money back yet. Refund it now? The money goes back through Razorpay or Stripe to the way the buyer paid. This can't be undone.
orders.refundDone: Refunded {{amount}}. The buyer has been told.
orders.needTracking: Type the tracking number to mark it shipped.
orders.trackingUrlBad: The tracking link must start with https://
orders.correctTrackingText: For a tracking number or courier that was typed wrongly. The buyer is told the order changed and sees the new details. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
orders.trackingDone: Tracking details corrected. The buyer has been told.
orders.undoTitle: Take this order one step back?
orders.undoText: It goes from "{{from}}" back to "{{to}}". The buyer is told the order changed. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
orders.undoClearsTracking: The courier and tracking number are taken off the order, because it has not shipped. You type them again when you mark it shipped.
orders.undoDone: Done. The order is back at: {{step}}. The buyer has been told.
orders.couponOverLimit: Code used beyond its limit: this order was paid late, after the buyer had already used the code.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Coupons, scrolling banners and promotional messages.
offers.couponsHelp: Coupons work for posters, books and premium invites. Discounts on AYWO Plus inside the iPhone and Android apps must be Apple or Google offer codes, made in their own consoles.
offers.usedNote: This code has been used, so its code and discount stay fixed. You can still change the dates and limits, or switch it off.
offers.codeHelp: 4 to 20 letters and numbers, for example DIWALI20.
offers.newOnly: Only for a person's first order
offers.showInApp: Show on the Offers screen in the app

placementsHelp.app_banner: Scrolling strip at the top of the app
placementsHelp.web_banner: Scrolling strip on the public website

offers.bannersHelp: Short news or offers that scroll across the top of the app or the website. Keep the title under 60 letters.
offers.bannerTitleHelp: This scrolls. Example: Diwali offer: 20% off family posters
offers.linkHelp: An app page like /offers, or a full https link.
offers.linkLabel: Button word, for example See offer
offers.linkBad: The link must start with / or https://
offers.messagesHelp: A push notification to people who switched on offers and news in the app. At most two a day. Safety and service news go through System notices instead.
offers.willReach_one: Goes to {{count}} person. {{optedIn}} people have switched on offers.
offers.willReach_other: Goes to {{count}} people. {{optedIn}} people have switched on offers.
offers.sendText: It can't be taken back. Your reason goes in the audit log.
offers.dateBad: This isn't a real day. Type year-month-day, like {{example}}.
offers.endBeforeStart: The end day is before the start day.
offers.dateHelp: Starts at the beginning of this day, India time.
offers.endHelp: Runs until the end of this day, India time. Tap Clear for no end.
offers.percentBad: The percentage must be a whole number from 1 to 90.
offers.amountBad: The amount must be more than 0.
offers.perUserBad: Uses per person must be from 1 to 100.
offers.needCode: Type a code of at least 4 letters or numbers.
offers.needTitle: Type a title of at least 3 letters.
offers.needValue: Type how much the coupon takes off.
offers.needProduct: Tick at least one thing the coupon works on.
offers.reviewCouponText: This coupon is switched on, so it takes money off real orders. Please check it once more.
offers.warnNoEnd: No end day: this coupon keeps working until someone switches it off.
offers.warnEnded: The end day has already passed, so this will not show or work.
offers.warnNoLimit: No limit on total uses: any number of orders can use it.
offers.warnBigPercent: {{percent}}% off is a large discount. Make sure this is what you mean.
offers.needBannerText: Type the banner text, at least 3 letters.
offers.needPlacement: Tick at least one place for the banner to show.
offers.reviewBannerText: This banner is switched on, so the people below see it as soon as it starts. Please check it once more.
offers.warnBannerNoEnd: No end day: this banner keeps showing until someone switches it off.
offers.needHeading: Type a heading of at least 3 letters.
offers.needMessage: Type a message of at least 5 letters.
offers.opensBad: This must be an app page that starts with /, for example /offers.
offers.needCount: Send stays off until we can count who will get this. Press Try again above.
offers.nobodyToSend: Nobody in this group has switched on offers, so there is no one to send to. Choose a wider group.
offers.countFailed: We couldn't count who will get this. {{why}}
offers.pickPage: Or pick the page it opens:
offers.cantDeleteUsed: Used on an order, so it can't be deleted. It can only be switched off.
offers.deleteCouponText: Nobody has used this code. It is removed for good and stops working at once. This is recorded in the audit log.
offers.switchOffText: The code stops working at once. Orders already paid with it keep their discount. You can switch it on again with Change.
offers.deleteBannerText: It is removed for good, with its view counts. This is recorded in the audit log.
offers.deleteBannerRunningText: This banner is showing to people right now. Deleting it takes it off at once and removes it for good, with its view counts. This is recorded in the audit log.
offers.previewStrip: The strip at the top of the app or website
offers.previewStripNoBody: The strip shows the title and the button text only. The longer text shows on the Home card.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Counts only. No one's family details appear here.

settings.title: App settings
settings.subtitle: Changes reach every app within a minute, without a new release.

confirm.min_version: Phones on an older version must update before they can use AYWO.
confirm.latest_version: Phones on an older version see a gentle reminder to update.
confirm.maintenance: While maintenance is on, everyone except staff sees the message instead of the app.
confirm.features: Switched-off features disappear from the apps at once.
confirm.whats_new: People see this once after updating to this version.
confirm.support: Shown on the Contact and Help pages.
confirm.store_links: The website's front page and the Update button in the apps open these links.
confirm.publisher: The Contact, Terms, Privacy and Refunds pages show these details to everyone.
confirm.emergency_numbers: The SOS screens offer these numbers to call. Check each one: people use them in an emergency.
confirm.faq: The FAQ page shows these questions to everyone.

settings.versionsHelp: Below the minimum, the app stops and asks for an update. Below the latest, it suggests one.
settings.maintenanceHelp: For planned work. SOS alarms that are already running keep working.
settings.maintenanceSwitch: Show the maintenance message instead of the app
settings.maintenanceMessage: Message, for example Back at 6 pm
settings.featuresHelp: Turn a feature off quickly if it misbehaves.
settings.whatsNewHelp: Shown once to people after they update. One line per item, up to six.
settings.healthHelp: Crashes the apps reported. Numbers, emails and ids are removed before saving. Kept 30 days.
settings.missingRow: This setting is missing on the server, so it can't be saved from here. Please tell the technical team.
settings.saved: Saved. The apps pick it up within a minute.
settings.versionBad: Type a version as three numbers with dots, like 1.4.0.
settings.supportHelp: The email address and hours people see on the Contact and Help pages.
settings.supportHoursExample: For example Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 6 pm India time
settings.supportEmailBad: Type a full email address, like help@example.com.
settings.supportHoursBad: Type the hours when support answers.
settings.storeLinksHelp: Where the website's front page sends people for each app. Leave a box empty while that app is not in its store yet: the front page then says "Coming soon" for it.
settings.storeAndroidBad: This must be the app's Google Play link, starting with https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=
settings.storeIosBad: This must be the app's App Store link, starting with https://apps.apple.com/

user360.title: Account
user360.subtitle: Everything staff may see about one account. Family details stay private.
user360.askTitle: Why are you opening this account?
user360.askText: Your name and reason go in the audit log, and the account's history shows it. You are asked once for each account; the reason is reused until you close this browser tab.
user360.creator: Creator

confirm.minus: Take free Plus days back from {{name}}?

confirmText.block: Signed out everywhere, and new sign-ins stop.
confirmText.unblock: The account can sign in again.
confirmText.end: Every phone and browser is signed out. The account stays open.
confirmText.plus: Added on top of any free days they already have. They get a notification.
confirmText.minus: For days given by mistake. The days come off the free Plus this account has left, including days earned by inviting people. Asking for more than is left ends free Plus today, never earlier. A paid plan is not touched, and the person gets no notification.

user360.reloadFailed: Your change may be saved, but this page couldn't be reloaded, so it may show old details. {{why}}
user360.staffLocked: This is a staff account. Only an AYWO Admin can block it or sign it out everywhere.

done.minus: Free Plus days taken back from {{name}}.

user360.daysBad: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365.
user360.reasonKept: Opened for your reason: {{reason}}. Each time this page loads, a look is recorded with it.

funnel.title: Step by step: devices that first opened the app in the last {{count}} days
funnel.help: Anonymous: a random id per device, no names or numbers. Each step counts once per device.
funnel.empty: No devices opened the app in this period yet.
funnel.biggestDrop: Most people stop before "{{step}}": {{count}} lost there.
funnel.splitLine: {{opened}} opened, {{verified}}% verified, {{tree}}% started a tree, {{five}}% reached 5 people

ops.noBackup: No good backup yet. Check that BACKUP_KEY is set (docs/runbook-backups.md).
ops.jobsFailing: Failing 3 times or more in a row: {{names}}

shopPictures.help: The photos people see in the shop for each product. The first one is the main picture on the product card. Up to {{max}} for each product. JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 15 MB; a wide photo (about 3 by 2) fits best.
shopPictures.full: This product already has {{max}} pictures. Remove one to add another.
shopPictures.none: No photo yet. The shop shows this drawing until you add one.
shopPictures.removeText: It will no longer show in the shop for {{product}}. To change a picture, remove it and add the new one.
shopPictures.added: Picture added to {{product}}. The shop shows it now.
shopPictures.madeMain: This is now the main picture.
shopPictures.wrongType: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
shopPictures.tooBig: That picture is larger than 15 MB. Choose a smaller one.

shopPrices.help: What each product costs. Buyers with an Indian phone number pay in rupees; everyone else pays in US dollars. A new price applies to orders started after you save; orders already made keep their price.
shopPrices.viewOnly: You can see the prices. Changing them needs the Payments permission.
shopPrices.dialogText: Type the price of one. Coupons take their discount off this price.
shopPrices.badInr: Type an amount between ₹1 and ₹1,00,000, such as 799 or 799.50.
shopPrices.badUsd: Type an amount between $0.50 and $2,000, such as 19.99.
shopPrices.bigJump: This is less than half or more than double the price now. Check the numbers before you save.
shopPrices.inviteNote: This price is for the website. Inside the iPhone and Android apps the premium invite is sold by the App Store and Google Play at the price set in their consoles.
shopPrices.needPrices: Still needed: both prices, as amounts of money.
shopPrices.needChange: Still needed: a price different from the one now.
shopPrices.needReason: Still needed: a reason, at least 5 characters.
shopPrices.saved: New price saved for {{product}}. The shop shows it now.

content.publisherHelp: Shown on the Contact, Terms, Privacy and Refunds pages, and in the FAQ. Leave a box empty to keep what the app was built with. A line whose detail is not set is hidden from the public pages.
content.publisherMissing: Still not set, so hidden on the public pages: {{list}}.
content.draft: Show "Draft: to be reviewed" on the legal pages. Untick once the lawyer has approved them.

fields.refundDays: Days to ask for a refund
fields.refundWorkingDays: Working days for the refund to arrive

content.emergencyHelp: The number the SOS screens offer to call, by country. One per line: the two-letter country code, a space, the number. A country not listed gets 112. Check every number before saving: people call it in an emergency.
content.emergencyLines: Country and number, one per line (for example: IN 112)
content.emergencyBad: This line is not right: "{{line}}". Write it like: IN 112
content.emergencyNeedsIndia: India (IN) must stay in the list.
content.faqHelp: Add your own questions and answers, and hide built-in ones that no longer fit. Changes show on the FAQ page within a few minutes of saving.
content.faqEnglishOnly: English only: Tamil readers see the English
content.faqBuiltInHelp: Untick a question to hide it from the FAQ page. Tick it again to bring it back.
content.faqNotSaved: Not saved yet. Press Save below to put these changes on the FAQ page.

plus.title: This needs AYWO Plus
plus.body: Chat, reactions, comments and a family plan of up to 6.

home.sosFrom: SOS from {{name}}. Tap to see where.

audience.nobody: No one yet. People appear once they join your tree or a group.
audience.allAdded: Everyone you could add is already in.

chat.title: Chat
chat.subtitle: Family groups and 1-to-1
chat.plusBody: Family chat, groups and voice notes come with AYWO Plus.
chat.empty: No chats yet. Start one with someone in your family.
chat.pickPerson: Who do you want to talk to?
chat.inviteHelp: You can chat with people once they join AYWO. Send them an invite.
chat.replyHint: Tap to reply. Hold your own message to delete it.
chat.reconnecting: Connecting. New messages will still arrive, a little slower.
chat.micDenied: Allow the microphone in your phone's settings to send voice notes.
chat.choicesHint: Opens reply, edit, delete and report
chat.leaveMessage: You will stop getting its messages. Someone in the chat can add you again.
chat.hideTitle: Remove this chat from your list?
chat.hideMessage: Only your list changes. The messages are kept, and the chat comes back when a new message arrives.

memories.title: Memories
memories.subtitle: From your trees and friends groups
memories.empty: No memories yet. Share the first one.
memories.noCircle: Join a tree or friends group first.
memories.helpersNote: Helpers can add photos and tag people.
memories.closedNote: Comments are closed. Nothing more can be added.
memories.deleteTitle: Delete this memory? This cannot be undone.
memories.photosFull: This memory already has 20 photos, which is the most it can hold. Remove one to add another.

groups.title: Friends groups
groups.subtitle: College, office and other groups
groups.empty: No groups yet. Start one and share the link.
groups.name: Group name
groups.linkNote: Friends outside your tree can join with this link.
groups.newLink: Make a new link and stop the old one
groups.joinAsk: Join {{name}}? Members see each other's names and can chat.
groups.deleteMessage: Everyone in it loses the group and its chat. This cannot be undone.
groups.removeMessage: They leave the group. You can add them again later.
groups.starterCannotLeave: You started this group, so you cannot leave it: nobody else could look after it. You can remove people, or delete the group.
groups.newLinkDone: A new link is ready. The old link no longer works.
groups.removedNewLink: Removed. The old join link no longer works, so they can't use it to come back. Share the new link with anyone who should still join.

invites.title: Invites
invites.subtitle: Family events, who is coming, and quick get-togethers
invites.premiumLater: Premium designs can be added after the invite is made.
invites.canvaLink: Link to a card you designed on the Canva website (optional)
invites.guests: How many others are coming with you?
invites.whoIsComingWithGuests: {{yes}} coming and {{guests}} more with them, of {{invited}} invited
invites.premiumNote: A one-time purchase for this invite.
invites.paymentWait: Your design appears here once the payment is confirmed.
invites.editTellsEveryone: Everyone invited gets a note that the details changed.
invites.uninviteMessage: They will no longer see it. You can invite them again.
invites.guestsAnswerFirst: Choose Yes, Maybe or No above: the number is saved with your answer.
invites.guestsSaved: Saved. The host can see the new number.
invites.removeCanvaMessage: People invited will no longer see the 'See the design' button. You can add a link again later.

pop.subtitle: A quick plan with polls
pop.name: What is the plan?
pop.oneEachLine: For places and food, write one choice on each line. Leave out anything already decided.
pop.familyFriendsOnly: Only people from your own trees and friends groups can be invited.
pop.filledFromVotes: Filled in from the choices with the most votes. Change anything you like.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Free. You choose who hears it.
alerts.empty: No alerts. That is good news.
alerts.neverBlast: Only the people you pick hear it.
alerts.confirmBody: Everyone you picked is told now, and may get a text.
alerts.deleteMessage: It goes from everyone's list. Use 'Mark as sorted' instead if they should still see it.
alerts.editNote: Everyone who got this alert will see the new words. They are not told again.

sos.entryHint: Alert your people in an emergency
sos.title: SOS
sos.subtitle: Free for everyone
sos.sendingIn: seconds until your contacts are alerted
sos.notEmergency: AYWO doesn't replace emergency services. In danger, call the emergency number.
sos.noContacts: Choose at least one contact before you can use SOS.
sos.contactsSubtitle: They get an alarm, a text and your live location
sos.prepareBody: Set location to 'Always' so an SOS keeps updating when the phone is locked.
sos.minutesLeft_one: Your contacts can see your location for {{count}} more minute
sos.minutesLeft_other: Your contacts can see your location for {{count}} more minutes
sos.noLocation: Location is off. Your contacts were still alerted.

consent.noticeTitle: Before you save: how we use your health details
consent.whatBody: Only what you type on this card: blood group, allergies, health conditions, regular medicines, and anything else you add. Every box is optional.
consent.whyBody: So the people your SOS reaches can help you safely, for example a doctor knowing your blood group or a medicine you must not be given. We use it for nothing else: no advertising, no profiling, never sold.
consent.whoBody: Only the people an SOS you send reaches, while it runs and for one day after. Not your family tree, not other members, and not our staff.
consent.howLongBody: Until you withdraw or delete your account. Withdrawing deletes the card at once.
consent.optionalBody: This is optional. SOS works the same without it.
consent.withdrawBody: Tap "Withdraw and delete" on this page or on Me, Privacy and account, My consents. It takes one tap, just like agreeing.
consent.complainBody: Write to our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, at {{grievanceEmail}}. You can also complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
consent.agreeLabel: I have read this and agree that AYWO may keep these health details and show them to the people my SOS reaches.
consent.tickFirst: Tick "I agree" first, or leave the health boxes empty. The card is only saved with your agreement.
consent.agreedOn: You agreed to keep this card on {{date}}.
consent.hiddenUntilAgree: Your SOS helpers can't see this card yet. Read the notice below and tick "I agree" to turn it on.
